title: Principal Cone Exact Equivalence
statement: For an additive equivalence H between abelian categories with countable products, and any cochain endomorphism μ:P→P, H applied degreewise to the principal completion is isomorphic to the principal completion of H(μ). Under this isomorphism the image of the specified normalized degree-zero completion unit is the specified completion unit. This is a chain-level comparison, before derived localization. Dependencies: [def-pur-principal-cone-tower].

See the declaration docstrings for the particular step.

proof.text: identify each finite mapping cone with the cone of the image endomorphism. The comparison preserves its two inclusions, hence the transition squares and the augmentation. The product comparison intertwines one minus the transition shift. Mapping the final cocone and using the shift comparison gives the completion isomorphism. Its equality on the normalized lift follows degree by degree from preservation of the cocone inclusion and the zero homotopy.

theorem principalCompletionMap [HasCountableProducts A] [HasCountableProducts B]
    [H.IsEquivalence] {P : CochainComplex A ℤ} (μ : End P) :
    ∃ i : (H.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (PrincipalCone.completion μ) ≅
        PrincipalCone.completion (End.of ((H.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map μ)),
      (H.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (PrincipalCone.unit μ) ≫ i.hom =
        PrincipalCone.unit (End.of ((H.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map μ))
